criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: 'Mat-Su banned plate readers the night it was heard.' is nine words, names a real Alaskan place, and the tension is the speed rather than the topic. Legible in the 432px thumb. Short of 9 on two counts: no number lands on the cover, because the ordinance prints no tally and the dek honestly surrendered 'ALL SEVEN MEMBERS' at the aggregate gate, so the count survives only as seven drawn ticks nobody counts at thumb size; and the map window is the largest mass on the frame while saying nothing specific at 432px.

criteria.name: Story arc and swipe momentum
criteria.notes: The open-loop chain is real and every link pays. 03 shows three enacted reaches and leaves the fourth terrace cut and empty, 04 pays it with the receiving clause, 05 is a genuine turn that re-scopes all four preceding frames with one quoted sentence, 06 answers it, 07 answers what is left, 09 asks. The round-5 addition to 07 plants 08 cleanly and names the date so the antecedent can't be the August signatures. Short of 9: 02 and 03 are reorderable without real loss, and 08 has to print a line telling the reader it is not about its own subject.

criteria.name: Artwork craft and genuine detail
criteria.notes: The biggest gain of this run and it was fixed at the cause. Seventeen lay warnings to zero by deriving the safe seedDeg from _layCheck rather than guessing. 03's four terraces carry per-terrace crossDeg and mirrored fall so they stop sharing one moire signature, plus the scotch rule the dossier had declared and the build had never drawn; 04's interior lost its raw flat fill for a bare-mainline pass; every frame carries a dedicated bottom-band surface pass, which designs out the six-run dead-lower-zone defect. Held at 8 by three things: 05's and 09's polygon interiors read close to bare at feed speed; four of nine frames are the same drawing at four tones; and the eight signature rules step in length on 09 while the same motif is uniform on 07.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: Art parameters encode story quantities on nearly every frame and each is declared with a claim id. Six riser ticks on 03's first terrace, one per verb in MSB 23.30.020(A), and three on the second, one per resource in (B). 04's milled channel stops 90px short of the borough mass, so the whole argument of the frame is a gap. 06's two bounded city chips carry all three engraving channels against a mainline-only plane. 08 encodes source class in the tag rule itself, solid for the primary document and dashed for the single secondary report, with a printed legend. Held at 8 because 07's main object now carries only its count and 09's length-stepping encodes nothing.
